name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Georgian Cabin 2-6 Person Outdoor Sauna w/ Porch
description: Dundalk Leisurecraft Georgian Cabin 2-6 Person Outdoor Sauna w/ Porch Sauna like a pro with the beautifully handcrafted CT Georgian Cabin Sauna with Porch. Made from Eastern White Cedar, this sauna radiates a natural beauty with its light color and tight knots. Whether for a cottage or home, its cabin shape blends seamlessly and can be easily assembled from a kit. The stylish addition of an overhang roof and front porch brings character to this model, while a black metal shingle roof ensures a dry and enjoyable sauna experience. Finally, the large front windows and built-in porch make this sauna a lasting investment for generations to come. Key Features Black Steel Roof 28 Gauge textured black metal roof Made in Canada. Front Windows Comes standard with 2 large front windows for natural light into your sauna. 2-Tier Benches 2 Tier Benches on the back wall with return L Bench that can be installed on the left or right side. Dovetail Corners Dovetail corner joinery makes for easy assembly and long lasting structure. Features 2-6 person capacity Made in Canada Premium metal shingle roof included Eastern White Cedar – light colour and knots 5mm bronze tempered glass Solid wide benches 8 kw heater recommended or wood burning Specifications Cubic Size: 343 Seating Capacity: 3 - 4 Gross Weight: 1775.85 Shipping Dimensions: 120 x 45 x 44 Useful Links Product Dimension Parts List
